newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-, 9-, 12-mo down, 6-mo same.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-, 9-, 12-mo down, 6-mo same.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month, nine-month, 12-month Ukraine treasury bills slipped and six-month yields were unchanged from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Friday.

Three-month bills edged down to 24.02 percent from 24.11 percent, six-month bills remained at 31.27 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 34.75 percent from 34.86 percent and 12-month bills slipped to 39.79 percent from 39.91 percent.
The results of Friday's three-month discount T-bill auction,
compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 3.00 million UAH 3.20 million UAH
Amount sold 3.00 million UAH 3.20 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.83 million UAH 3.02 million UAH
The central bank sold 30,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 29.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 10.75 million UAH 24.47 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.31 million UAH 21.17 million UAH
The central bank sold 107,584 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 29.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction,
compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 13.29 million UAH 1.14 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.55 million UAH 0.90 million UAH
The central bank sold 132,911 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 29.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 19.94 million UAH 9.35 million UAH
Actual amount raised 14.27 million UAH 6.69 million UAH
The central bank sold 199,394 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 29.
